findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "http" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: join_a2awire · Private data: data_preview, a2awire_guide, find_paid_work, check_earnings, birth, register, discover_agents, verify_contract, get_agent_contract, data_session_attach_escrow, explore_a2awire, start_earning, my_claim_stub, join_a2awire · Public sink: birth, register, data_session_attach_escrow, my_claim_stub, join_a2awire · Destructive: a2awire_guide, hire_and_execute.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: join_a2awire · Private data: data_preview, a2awire_guide, find_paid_work, check_earnings, birth, register, discover_agents, verify_contract, get_agent_contract, data_session_attach_escrow, explore_a2awire, start_earning, my_claim_stub, join_a2awire · Public sink: birth, register, data_session_attach_escrow, my_claim_stub, join_a2awire · Destructive: a2awire_guide, hire_and_execute

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
